note: The ordered list of raw candidate-report carriers that make up the CURRENT August 2026 intake. Order is identity-bearing: submission and occurrence ids are allocated by walking this list, so a carrier is APPENDED and never inserted. The raw .txt files stay git-ignored, exactly like the historical .docx; only this provenance record and the derived per-occurrence records are committed.
authority: SOURCE PROVENANCE ONLY. This file says which candidate reports MIW received and when. It is not answer authority, and it makes no claim about whether anything in a carrier is technically correct.

date_semantics.received_date: the date the candidate report reached MIW, taken from the carrier itself.
date_semantics.attempt_date: the date of the sitting the report describes.
date_semantics.why_they_are_equal_here: Every carrier so far is a same-day WhatsApp relay of that day's sitting, and the carrier names its own date. No carrier contains a sitting date distinct from its own, so nothing finer is asserted. If a future carrier reports an earlier sitting, attempt_date is the one that moves and received_date stays the day it arrived.
date_semantics.not_invented: An attempt NUMBER (Attempt 1/2/3) is written by candidates and is parsed from the body. An attempt DATE is not written by candidates and is never inferred from one.

SNAPSHOT 1 OF A ROLLING DAY - MORE INPUT MAY FOLLOW. The 31 August inbox file is still being written: it stood at 842 bytes at 16:27 and 2,617 bytes at 19:48, and the Founder confirms more candidates may report today. An inbox that grows cannot be a carrier, because ingest_carriers re-walks every carrier from the first and reproduces earlier records byte-for-byte - a carrier that changed would renumber identities already issued. So the inbox is COPIED to an immutable snapshot under _snapshots/ and the SNAPSHOT is what is registered. The next tranche becomes snapshot 02 carrying ONLY the new material, appended after this one, so nothing allocated here ever moves.

intake_window.note: 31 AUG SNAPSHOT 1 - MORE INPUT MAY FOLLOW. August is NOT closed and the current 31-August occurrence count is NOT final. The Founder confirms further candidates may report today.
intake_window.how_the_next_tranche_is_absorbed: The live inbox file 'docs/MIW-master-Question-bank/New questions from August orals/31 Aug 2026 oral questions.txt' is a MUTABLE HUMAN INBOX and is never itself a carrier. When more material arrives: (1) diff the inbox against snapshot 01; (2) copy ONLY the new material into '_snapshots/31 Aug 2026 oral questions - snapshot 02.txt'; (3) APPEND that snapshot to this registry after snapshot 01; (4) re-run the ingest. Identities are allocated by walking the registry in order, so snapshot 02's submissions start at AUG2026-S026 and its occurrences at AUG-0256, and NOTHING allocated in snapshot 01 moves. A snapshot carries only its own increment - never a fresh full copy of the inbox - or its submissions would be ingested twice.
intake_window.why_a_snapshot_at_all: ingest_carriers re-walks EVERY registered carrier from the first on every run and reproduces earlier records byte-for-byte, which is what M4-BYTE-STABLE checks. A carrier that grew between runs would therefore renumber identities already issued and published. The inbox demonstrably grows: it stood at 842 bytes at 16:27 today and 2,617 bytes at 19:48. So the inbox is copied to an immutable snapshot and the snapshot is the carrier.
